facts.fact: 一头白蹄的雄鹿落在屋里。
facts.anchor: A majestic stag landed on white hooves.

facts.fact: 中央巨树里透出的白光分出九条尾巴。
facts.anchor: Nine tails.

facts.fact: Jingling 从柱子后爬出来，钻向房间正中的木堆。
facts.anchor: Jingling scrabbled out from behind a pillar like a scurrying mouse

facts.fact: 她站着问妹妹有没有受伤，脚却动不了。
facts.anchor: “Jingling, are you hurt?” Kiamling stood there like some gawking idiot, unable to get her feet to move.

facts.fact: 那头兽自称 Merlin，说她会带来毁灭。
facts.anchor: “I am Merlin, wisest of prophets, greatest of druids. And you, Au Kiamling, will bring doom upon us all.”

facts.fact: 她从鹿头上方跃过，落在鹿背上，是倒着骑的。
facts.anchor: She was straddling his back, albeit backwards.

facts.fact: 她骑在鹿背上时把红绳放成歪斜的螺旋。
facts.anchor: Spread around the room in a jerky spiral was the red string Kiamling had unspooled as she straddled the stag’s back.

facts.fact: 她合指打出火星，点燃红绳，把 Merlin 困住。
facts.anchor: Kiamling brought her fingers together and sparks lit the red string.

facts.fact: 女鬼们扯开藤蔓，放出了 Madam Yau。
facts.anchor: The lui gwei had succeeded in tearing away the vines to free Madam Yau.

facts.fact: 她现在看出那些女鬼是受害者。
facts.anchor: Now she saw them as they truly were. Victims.

facts.fact: 没有祖母维持护障，春芽阁成了灵气汇聚的焦点。
facts.anchor: Without Por Por maintaining whatever protective barriers kept the place safe, the Pavilion of Spring Buds had become a focal point of spiritual energy.

facts.fact: 她推断把他封进树里就能把门关上。
facts.anchor: In which case the opposite might also be true: sealing him inside would close it.

facts.fact: Madam Yau 说由她去做饵，因为他恨的是她。
facts.anchor: “I’ll do it. After all, it’s me he detests.”

facts.fact: 她用 Jingling 那只硬底靴的靴跟砸符纸。
facts.anchor: Kiamling hammered the heel of the boot onto the paper slip.

facts.fact: 她想起祖母在盂兰节当着 Nairns 牧师的面吞下符咒。
facts.anchor: She recalled Por Por swallowing the curse in front of Reverend Nairns at the Hungry Ghost Festival.

facts.fact: 女鬼透明的手指碰到他时变成银色，把他的气吸走。
facts.anchor: their transparent fingers turned silver, leaching the qi from him

facts.fact: 这说明那副形体底下有一个人类宿主。
facts.anchor: Which meant… there was a human host beneath that form.

facts.fact: 一道桅杆粗的锯齿状闪电直劈下来。
facts.anchor: A single jagged lightning strike pierced down, thick as the mast of a junk ship

facts.fact: 树桩上的脸是常客 Francis Peake 秘书。
facts.anchor: “Secretary Francis Peake,” Madam Yau said, voice wrung out. “He’s a regular.”

facts.fact: 门被推开，Archie 站在门口喘气。
facts.anchor: The main door burst open behind them. Archie stood there, out of breath.
